items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: He had Ward Pinkett. Hmm, I've forgotten who the other one was. ... I'm sure he replaced Pinkett, yes... Because something happened between Pinkett and Teddy, so he had to replace Pinkett.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, I mean, we'd worked with all them guys on... Yeah. He was at the Nest Club when I first met Russell.

So I go up to the Savoy with Teddy Hill, and there was Blanchard, a saxophone player in the band, Teddy Hill and myself -- we were the reed section. He had Ward Pinkett. Hmm, I've forgotten who the other one was. And somebody else, I don't know just exactly who it was.
